where: 米沙 gives it to you at 国子监, after the library disaster (chapter 4).

pages.zh: 中文有四个声调。一个字，声调不对，意思就不对。
pages.en: Chinese has four tones. Get a syllable's tone wrong, and you get the meaning wrong.

pages.zh: 包子是 bāozi，豹子是 bàozi。包子可以吃，豹子……不能吃！
pages.en: 包子 is bāozi, 豹子 is bàozi. You can eat a bun. A leopard… you can't!

pages.zh: 水饺是 shuǐjiǎo，睡觉是 shuìjiào。想吃东西，吃水饺；累了，去睡觉。
pages.en: 水饺 is shuǐjiǎo, 睡觉 is shuìjiào. Want to eat: dumplings. Tired: go to sleep.

pages.zh: 问是 wèn，吻是 wěn。问问题，可以。吻……不可以！
pages.en: 问 is wèn, 吻 is wěn. Asking a question — fine. Kissing… not fine!

pages.zh: 米沙说：我说错了很多很多。但是，我每天都听，每天都说。
pages.en: 米沙 says: I've got it wrong lots and lots. But I listen every day, and speak every day.

pages.zh: 你也是：多听，多说。说错了，没关系！
pages.en: You too: listen a lot, speak a lot. Getting it wrong is fine!

today.zh: 今天的北京：北京人说话很快。听不懂的时候，你可以说：“请慢一点说！”
today.en: In Beijing today: Beijing people talk fast. When you don't understand, you can say: “Please speak a bit more slowly!”
